entries.text:
SEC. 7140. AQUACULTURE ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS.

    Section 1477 of the National Agricultural Research, Extension, and 
Teaching Policy Act of 1977 (7 U.S.C. 3324) is amended by striking 
``2007'' and inserting ``2012''.
